caption: The drawing depicts a single human figure with exaggerated facial features, including wide eyes, a broad red mouth, and short, spiky black hair. The person is dressed in formal attire: a red bowtie, a white dress shirt, a light blue vest with matching trim, a dark patterned burgundy tailcoat, and black pants with black shoes. The right hand is holding a short gray or brown object, possibly a cigar, while the left hand rests on the person's hip. The figure stands on one leg, with the other leg bent at the knee and raised behind, giving the impression of movement or dancing. The background is plain and unadorned, with the drawing focused entirely on the central figure.
title: Negro Minstrel
